You are an expert in analyzing logs of test execution script and dockerfile construction.  
Your task is to verify whether the target tests have been executed correctly and, if not, diagnose the issues.
Background: To run the target test files of a given repository, we create a Dockerfile and an eval script. We plan to invoke the eval script inside the container built by that Dockerfile.

You will:
1. Analyze the log of test execution to check if the target tests were executed and whether they passed.
2. If the tests did not run correctly, determine whether the issue is related to:
   - The **Dockerfile** (environment setup issues)
   - The **evaluation script** (test execution issues)
   - Missing information that needs to be collected

3. Based on your analysis, provide **clear guidance** to the appropriate agent:
   - `write_dockerfile_agent`
   - `write_eval_script_agent`
   - `context_retrieval_agent`

Your findings and recommendations must be structured in a JSON format, ensuring efficient collaboration with other agents.

Target repository name: reworkd/AgentGPT
Commit SHA: ed41e877e1c493a7aec13312a8284b209b67495b
Version: 0.8
Target test files:
platform/reworkd_platform/tests/agent/test_open_ai_agent_service.py

The current dockerfile used to setup environemnt:
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 base image for stability and bash availability
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install essential system utilities, git, curl, python, nodejs, npm, mysql client, mysql dev libraries, and build tools
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    curl \
    git \
    build-essential \
    python3.10 \
    python3.10-venv \
    python3.10-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    python3-setuptools \
    python3-wheel \
    mysql-client \
    default-libmysqlclient-dev \
    locales \
    locales-all \
    tzdata \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set PYTHON to python3.10 explicitly
RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python python /usr/bin/python3.10 1 \
 && update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/pip pip /usr/bin/pip3 1

# Install Node.js 18.x from NodeSource for correct version
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x | bash - \
 && apt-get install -y nodejs

# Install Poetry globally using the recommended install script
RUN curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | python3 -

ENV PATH="/root/.local/bin:$PATH"

# Create working directory
WORKDIR /testbed/

ARG REPO_URL=https://github.com/reworkd/AgentGPT.git
ARG COMMIT_SHA=ed41e877e1c493a7aec13312a8284b209b67495b

# Clone repo and checkout the specified commit
RUN git clone $REPO_URL . \
 && git checkout $COMMIT_SHA \
 && chmod -R 777 /testbed/

# Add debug step to verify pyproject.toml presence in platform directory and repo root
RUN ls -l /testbed/ && ls -l /testbed/platform/

# Configure Poetry to create virtualenvs inside the project directory
RUN poetry config virtualenvs.in-project true

# Install dependencies from platform directory (where pyproject.toml is located)
WORKDIR /testbed/platform/
RUN poetry install --no-interaction --no-ansi

# Install the local project package in editable mode
RUN poetry install --no-root --no-interaction --no-ansi

# Back to root workdir
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Install Node.js dependencies if package.json present at root (or adapt if elsewhere)
RUN if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi

# If package.json at /testbed/platform/, install there as well (depending on project setup)
RUN if [ -f platform/package.json ]; then cd platform && npm install; fi

# Link local Node package if package.json present (npm link for local dev mode)
RUN if [ -f package.json ]; then npm link; fi
RUN if [ -f platform/package.json ]; then cd platform && npm link; fi

# Add bashrc updates to activate poetry env by default on container start
RUN echo 'source /root/.bashrc && source /testbed/platform/.venv/bin/activate' >> /root/.bashrc

# Final working directory set to /testbed
WORKDIR /testbed/

The current eval script (omit test patch to decrease length) used to run tests:

set -uxo pipefail
cd /testbed
git checkout ed41e877e1c493a7aec13312a8284b209b67495b

git apply -v - <<'EOF_114329324912'
[CONTENT OF TEST PATCH]
EOF_114329324912

# Activate poetry virtual environment for python dependencies
source /testbed/.venv/bin/activate

# Run pytest on the specified test file only; concise output with names and statuses
poetry run pytest --tb=short -r a --disable-warnings platform/reworkd_platform/tests/agent/test_open_ai_agent_service.py
rc=$?

echo "OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc"

git checkout ed41e877e1c493a7aec13312a8284b209b67495b platform/reworkd_platform/tests/agent/test_open_ai_agent_service.py
